notes.title: Update notes for 2025-05-13
notes.notes:
Content and bugfixes.

Two new questlines along with some individual room reworks
- Know Your Shrooms
- Boon of the All-Father
10 new achievements
3 new items
1 new enemy

notes.title: Post-Release Content Drop!
notes.notes:
[h2][i][b]Tower of the Ice Lich [/b][/i]has already been out over a month – and we couldn’t be more grateful for all the feedback, bug reports and ideas you’ve shared with us![/h2]

As a way to say thank you and keep the adventure going we have prepared a content drop for you!

[u][b]What's New:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Two new questlines along with some individual room reworks
[*] Know Your Shrooms 
[*] Boon of the All-Father 
[*] 10 new achievements
[*] 3 new items
[*] 1 new enemy
[/list]

We hope you’ll enjoy diving into the new content – and as always, we’d love to hear what you think. Your feedback helps shape the Adventure.

Arcane Lorelabs

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Streaming
notes.notes:
Since our game is very niche we decided to have gameplay streamed to help you decide if it's something for you. 

We're hoping to have a live stream later during the week with us developers talking about design choices and what had to be cut from the scope and added to our next game
